_doc: STRM1: the streamer reader and TCDM sparse interconnect grid (strm/gen.py). snax_cluster is read at this commit only; its generators run in the image on a git-archive copy in tmp/strm/.

fixed._doc: platforms/snax_forge_cluster.hjson in snax-forge: 64-bit TCDM of 128 KiB, spatial_bounds [num_channel], no configurable_channel, no datapath extension, no tcdm_logic_word_size (256), dynamicPriority as its default (true)

xbar.name: i{inputs}_b{banks}
xbar.extra_doc: CSYN1 R3c: points after the axes' product. i36_b32 is the cluster's interconnect (32 streamer channels, 2 cores, the AXI port; 32 banks), the base of xbar_mix's i36_b32 points; not in STRM1's table (report/strm_table.py reads results/xbar/, where it is not synthesized)

fixed._doc: snaxgen.py (Generating Sparse Interconnect) for a 128 KiB TCDM of 64-bit words: tcdmAddrWidth = log2(128 KiB) = 17; memAddrWidth = log2(128 KiB / banks / 8 B); priorityWidth 1 (a literal there); userWidth = core_id_width + 2 = 3 for snax_forge_cluster's 2 cores (the platform's user_width 3); strbWidth = dataWidth / 8; sparseConfig [[NumInp, 1]]

xbar_mix._doc: CSYN1 R3c (docs X70): the xbar point's SparseInterconnect inside strm/xbar_mix.py's wrapper, which ties inputs 0..ro-1 read-only (write, data, amo 0) and ro..ro+wo-1 write-only (write 1, amo 0, response data open), and every point as snax_cluster's sparse_interconnect_wrapper.sv.tpl does (response ready 1, bank response valid 1, bank response ready and request priority open). No sbt: the SV is rtl/xbar/i<inputs>_b<banks>.zip's. mixes per inputs x banks: rw = r0_w0 (every input read-write), ro = r<inputs>_w0 (every input read-only), wo = r0_w<inputs> (every input write-only); then the extra points: i36_b32 all read-write and the cluster's mix (32 reader channels, 1 writer, 2 cores and the AXI port read-write)
xbar_mix.name: i{inputs}_b{banks}_r{ro}_w{wo}
